The Farwell Law Firm, LLC is located in Kirksville, Missouri and has served clients in over 30 counties throughout the state. We have tried jury trials for our clients from Kansas City to Hannibal, and even in the State of California. We provide confidential and experienced representation of clients in litigation matters such as personal injury, wrongful death and criminal proceedings as well as contract, estate, and real estate disputes. Please feel free to browse our website and call us with your legal questions.
